chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"Remove the hair from yourselves, for it beautifies."

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: the kunyah of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام say about removing body hair?
ai.summary: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام instructs removing bodily hair as a practice of cleanliness and beautification. The statement reflects Islamic attention to personal hygiene and good appearance.
